payload.goal: Board redline round 1 applied: the owner's 14-point ruleset (no footer, DRY header, watchdog dots, LED iteration list oldest-first one-line, agent tabs, 3x3 fixed-thirds layout with details-pane fallback, session-scoped log, filter help, toll todo checklist) plus the adhere-to-sketch law in the contract.
payload.load_bearing_for: The board is the owner's only always-on window into agent work; a board that invents visual elements beyond the owner's sketch (footer, duplicated state) erodes exactly the trust it exists to build — caught live in today's design round.
payload.exit_check: Engine verify green: board tests cover the new projection fields (session-scoped calls, agent name); the owner redlines the live board and blesses the gate when the round satisfies.
